summary_en: HIRATA Corporation authorized acquisition of up to 3.2 million shares (10.4% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 10 billion yen through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 16, 2026 to March 31, 2027 to enhance capital efficiency and shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
HIRATA Corporation's Board of Directors resolved on November 13, 2026 to acquire its own shares pursuant to Article 459(1) of the Companies Act and Article 27 of the company's articles of incorporation. The company will acquire up to 3.2 million shares, representing 10.4% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum aggregate consideration of 10 billion yen. Purchases will be executed through open market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from November 16, 2026 through March 31, 2027. The authorization applies to ordinary shares of HIRATA Corporation only. At September 30, 2026, the company held 1,626,997 treasury shares (including those in trust accounts) against 30,641,273 outstanding shares excluding treasury stock.

The stated objectives of the share acquisition are three-fold: to improve capital efficiency, to return profits to shareholders, and to secure flexibility and agility in capital policy in response to changing business conditions. No maximum price per share was specified in this authorization; the 10 billion yen limit is an aggregate cap on expenditure.
